svg.title: TCRen: two scoring routes and a structural toolkit
svg.desc: Schematic TCR, peptide and MHC contacts branch into a residue statistical potential for epitope ranking and measured affinity, response and kinetic associations, and a confidence-context score combining ipTM, Betti fraction and mock-calibrated enrichment for binder/non-binder and binder/mock ranking. Shared diagnostics include geometry, surfaces, contacts, visualization and matched statistics.
